name: Order
description: A confirmed request from a customer to move freight. Has its own lifecycle (draft → confirmed → in-transit → delivered, or cancelled) independent of the customer, which is why it is a separate aggregate rather than embedded. The foreign key to the customer lives here, on the many side.

attributes.name: number
attributes.label: Order number
attributes.description: Human-facing order identifier printed on paperwork (e.g. ORD-2026-00142). Unique per org; generated on confirmation.

attributes.name: customer_id
attributes.label: Customer
attributes.description: The customer who placed this order. Set at creation and never changed — re-assigning means voiding and re-issuing.

meta.description: Each order is placed by exactly one customer; a customer places many orders. on_delete is restrict: a customer with orders cannot be deleted until they are repointed or removed — orders are financial history, never silently dropped.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: Status
attributes.description: Fulfilment lifecycle position. Gates which fields are editable (commercial terms lock once in-transit) and drives operational dashboards.

values.label: Draft
values.description: Being prepared; not yet committed. Fully editable; excluded from revenue and ops reporting.

values.label: Confirmed
values.description: Committed by the customer and accepted by ops. Awaiting pickup; commercial terms still editable.

values.label: In transit
values.description: Freight has been picked up and is moving. Commercial terms are locked; only tracking updates are allowed.

values.label: Delivered
values.description: Delivered and confirmed by the consignee. Terminal success state; the order becomes read-only.

values.label: Cancelled
values.description: Voided before delivery. Terminal state; requires a cancellation reason and is retained for audit.

attributes.name: total
attributes.label: Order total
attributes.description: The all-in price quoted to the customer for this order, in the order's currency. Locked once the order is in-transit. Stored as an exact decimal amount plus currency code.

attributes.name: placed_at
attributes.label: Placed at
attributes.description: When the customer confirmed the order. Set on the draft → confirmed transition; drives lead-time and on-time reporting.
